title: [BUG] VS Code extension: focus ping-pongs between two visible Claude panels when the window regains focus (refs #71809, #79770)
outputText: two visible Claude webviews in split editor groups; window regains OS focus; each iframe window-level focus listener restores composer; guard is document.activeElement === body; per-document activeElement; visibility_changed carries only isVisible; panel.active tracked but not sent; setTimeout(..., 0) offsets the two cycles; caret flickers; typing is impossible
